subject: microbiology
title: Oxidase-Positive Neisseria, Maltose Fermentation, Waterhouse-Friderichsen and Meningococcal Vaccines

steps.tx: The **oxidase test** (Kovac reagent turning purple within seconds by cytochrome c oxidase) places Neisseria, Moraxella, Pseudomonas, Vibrio and Campylobacter on one bench branch, all Enterobacterales negative. In diplococcal work it is the second move after Gram stain, colony oxidase deciding whether sugar utilisation is worth setting up.
steps.say: Purple in ten seconds routes the colony to Neisseria work; enterics never colour.

left.title: Oxidase technique
points: Fresh colonies, avoid selective media dyes

steps.tx: **Maltose fermentation** divides the pathogenic Neisseria: meningococcus ferments glucose and maltose (acid in cysteine tryptic agar sugars), gonococcus glucose only, commensal Neisseria broader patterns, while modern benches confirm by MALDI, NAAT and enzyme substrates (gamma glutamyl for meningococcus). One sugar carried a century of speciation.
steps.say: Maltose yes meningococcus, no gonococcus: one sugar, two empires.

left.title: Sugar patterns
points: CTA sugars need heavy inoculum and serum

right.title: Modern confirmation
points: Serogrouping antisera for meningococcus beyond species

steps.tx: **Waterhouse Friderichsen syndrome** is meningococcal sepsis at its most theatrical: bilateral adrenal haemorrhage and infarction inside DIC and shock, historically autopsy defined, suspected when refractory shock meets purpura fulminans, supported by critical care and stress steroid debates, prognosis set by shock reversal speed rather than the adrenal finding alone.
steps.say: Purpura, DIC, collapsing pressure: adrenal haemorrhage is the syndrome's autopsy signature.

left.title: Syndrome mechanics
points: Endotoxin LOS cytokine and complement storm

right.title: Syndrome care
points: Steroids for refractory shock by critical care judgement
Surgical and plastics for necrotic limbs later

steps.tx: **Meningococcal vaccines** divide by serogroup: conjugate MenACWY (carriage reducing, infant to adolescent programmes, Hajj requirement), protein based MenB vaccines (fHbp, NadA, PorA components, adolescent and outbreak and risk use), and pentavalent combinations emerging. B capsule mimics neural polysialic acid, which is why B needed proteins.
steps.say: Conjugates stop carriage for A C W Y; B needed proteins because its coat mimics brain.

left.title: Conjugate MenACWY
points: T dependent infant and adolescent responses

steps.tx: **Chemoprophylaxis circles** after a case are drawn by exposure intimacy (household, dormitory room, kissing contacts, airway procedures unprotected), not casual contact: rifampicin two days, ciprofloxacin single dose (resistance watched), ceftriaxone single injection (pregnancy), ideally within 24 hours and worthwhile to 14 days. Index case also receives eradication if treated without ceftriaxone.
steps.say: Prophylax the household and the kiss, not the classroom; circles follow saliva and airways.

left.title: Contact definitions
points: Child care close contacts by assessment
Casual school and work usually excluded

steps.tx: **Commensal Neisseria and Moraxella** prevent overcalling: lactamica and cinerea in throats (gonococcus mimics in children's cultures with legal consequences, confirmation mandatory), Moraxella catarrhalis (oxidase positive diplococcus of otitis, sinusitis and COPD exacerbations, hockey puck colonies, beta lactamase near universal) on the next lesson's edge.
steps.say: A throat gonococcus in a child must be proven past commensal mimics before lives are rearranged.

left.title: Commensal traps
points: N lactamica: lactose positive throat commensal
Confirm genital and paediatric isolates rigorously

right.title: Moraxella catarrhalis
points: Beta lactamase BRO enzymes almost universal

steps.tx: **Superoxol and DNase bench details** finish speciation heritage: superoxol (30 percent peroxide vigorous bubbling) suggests gonococcus among Neisseria, DNase and tributyrin sort Moraxella, while chromogenic enzyme substrates compressed the sugar era into hours. Old tests remain viva currency because their logic is species biology.
steps.say: Superoxol fizzes for gonococcus; every rapid panel is these logics miniaturised.

right.title: Confirmation ethics
points: Retain cultures in abuse investigations by protocol

steps.tx: **Meningococcal disease surveillance** tracks serogroup, age and vaccine programme effects (MenB infant programmes, adolescent MenACWY herd), genomics detecting hyperinvasive lineages (cc11 W expansion) and capsule switching. Bench sugar becomes sequence; public health reads both. Genomic surveillance also watches vaccine antigen variants, because protein based MenB coverage depends on which surface proteins circulating strains actually express.
steps.say: Serogroup plus sequence decides whether a case is tragedy or outbreak beginning.

nodes.label: Programme impact and strain shifts reviewed
